tokens.name: dark-blue
tokens.usage: Primary · Dark Blue — RGB 0 26 71 · CMYK 100 91 0 48 · PMS 282 C. Ink for headlines, body copy and the wordmark; the dark ground for white logos, white text and Cyber Blue / Cyber Green accents.

tokens.name: sophos-blue
tokens.usage: Primary · Sophos Blue — RGB 32 6 247 · CMYK 100 78 0 0 · PMS 2736 C. The brandmark colour and the primary interactive colour (CTAs, links, selected states) on light grounds. White text on it reads 8.6:1; never put it on Dark Blue as text (1.96:1).

tokens.name: cyber-blue
tokens.usage: Primary · Cyber Blue — RGB 0 237 255 · CMYK 59 0 0 0 · PMS 311 C. Interactive and accent colour on Dark Blue grounds (11.7:1). Never as text or lines on white (1.44:1); as a fill, set Dark Blue text on it.

tokens.name: cyber-green
tokens.usage: Primary · Cyber Green — RGB 0 242 179 · CMYK 59 0 48 0 · PMS 2239 C. Signature accent: icon accents on dark, highlight fills, the green CTA. Dark Blue text on it (11.6:1); never as text on white (1.46:1).

tokens.name: light-neutral
tokens.usage: Primary · Light Neutral — RGB 237 242 249 · CMYK 5 2 0 0 · PMS 656 C. Light ground for sections, cards and logo panels; Dark Blue text on it reads 15:1.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Secondary — RGB 16 3 124 · CMYK 100 100 0 17 · PMS 2738 C (the guide names no swatch name; descriptive name). Deep supporting fill; white text on it 15.8:1. Indistinguishable from Dark Blue as a ground (1.07:1) — never place one on the other.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Secondary — RGB 90 0 255 · CMYK 77 78 0 0 · PMS 2098 C (unnamed in the guide). Supporting accent and this system's focus ring on light grounds (7.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: fusion-purple
tokens.usage: Secondary · Fusion Purple — RGB 181 41 247 · CMYK 51 80 0 0 · PMS 2582 C. Named in the Sophos Fusion core palette. Supporting accent; 4.5:1 on white, so large text or fills only on light, never small text on Dark Blue (3.7:1).

tokens.name: sky-blue
tokens.usage: Secondary — RGB 0 156 251 · CMYK 76 31 0 0 · PMS 2191 C (unnamed in the guide). Informational fills and data series; Dark Blue text on it (5.8:1); fails as text on white (2.9:1).

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Secondary and neutral — RGB 106 136 155 · CMYK 63 39 30 2 · PMS 2178 C. Control borders and meaningful dividers (3.7:1 on white, 4.5:1 on Dark Blue). Not for body text on white (3.74:1 misses 4.5:1).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Neutral — the default light page ground and the reversed logo/text colour on dark grounds.

tokens.name: neutral-300
tokens.usage: Neutral — RGB 187 207 222 · CMYK 26 11 7 0. Hairline dividers on light grounds (decorative only, 1.6:1) and muted text on Dark Blue (10.6:1).

tokens.name: neutral-800
tokens.usage: Neutral — RGB 34 62 76 · CMYK 87 65 51 41. Secondary/muted text on white (11.3:1) and Light Neutral (10:1).

tokens.name: alert-red
tokens.usage: Alert — RGB 234 0 34 · CMYK 2 100 98 0 (guide gives no name). Critical severity fill with white text (4.64:1); error text on white.

tokens.name: alert-orange
tokens.usage: Alert — RGB 242 148 0 · CMYK 2 49 100 0. High severity fill; Dark Blue text on it (7.3:1).

tokens.name: alert-yellow
tokens.usage: Alert — RGB 248 227 0 · CMYK 5 4 100 0. Medium severity / warning fill; Dark Blue text on it (12.9:1). Never as text.

tokens.name: alert-lime
tokens.usage: Alert — RGB 170 255 0 · CMYK 36 0 100 0. Low severity fill; Dark Blue text on it (13.7:1). Never as text.

tokens.name: alert-green
tokens.usage: Alert — RGB 0 239 11 · CMYK 66 0 100 0. Safe / resolved fill; Dark Blue text on it (10.8:1). Red and green differ by only 2.95:1 in lightness — always pair them with a word or icon.

tokens.name: fusion-purple-start
tokens.usage: Sophos Fusion purple gradient · stop 1 (0%). Only inside the gradient-fusion-purple token.

tokens.name: fusion-purple-mid
tokens.usage: Sophos Fusion purple gradient · stop 2 (50%).

tokens.name: fusion-purple-end
tokens.usage: Sophos Fusion purple gradient · stop 3 (100%).

tokens.name: fusion-green-start
tokens.usage: Sophos Fusion green gradient · stop 1 (0%).

tokens.name: fusion-green-mid
tokens.usage: Sophos Fusion green gradient · stop 2 (50%).

tokens.name: fusion-green-end
tokens.usage: Sophos Fusion green gradient · stop 3 (100%) — the same value as Cyber Green.

tokens.name: sophos-blue-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of the Sophos Blue CTA, as rendered in the guide's CTA specimen. White text 11.9:1.

tokens.name: cyber-blue-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of the Cyber Blue CTA (guide CTA specimen). Dark Blue text 9.2:1.

tokens.name: cyber-green-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of the Cyber Green CTA (guide CTA specimen). Dark Blue text 8.9:1.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page ground. Light: White. Dark: Dark Blue. Text-strong, text-body and text-muted all pass 4.5:1 on it in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Section bands, tinted panels, logo plates. Light: Light Neutral. Dark: #0f2852 — Dark Blue with 6% white, a UI tint this system derives (not a guide swatch).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, toasts, inputs. Light: White (separate it with border-subtle). Dark: #1a3159 — Dark Blue with 10% white, derived UI tint.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Dark feature panels inside a light page (and the reverse in dark). Pair with text-on-inverse.

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: Sophos Blue panels and section dividers. White text only (8.6:1); keep Cyber Blue/Green off it.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Headlines and labels. 17:1 on surface-page, 15:1 on surface-subtle (light); White on Dark Blue in dark (17:1), 12.9:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body copy — the guide sets body in Dark Blue on light. Dark: Light Neutral (15:1 on Dark Blue, 11.5:1 on surface-raised).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, hints, captions. Light: #223E4C (11.3:1 on white, 10:1 on Light Neutral). Dark: #BBCFDE (10.6:1 on Dark Blue, 8:1 on surface-raised).

tokens.name: text-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: text-brand
tokens.usage: Links, selected tabs, brand accents in text. Light: Sophos Blue (8.6:1 on white, 7.7:1 on Light Neutral). Dark: Cyber Blue (11.7:1 on Dark Blue, 8.9:1 on surface-raised).

tokens.name: text-critical
tokens.usage: Error messages. Light: Alert Red (4.64:1 on white). Dark: #f37385 — Alert Red lightened 45% toward white (derived; 6.1:1 on Dark Blue, 4.7:1 on surface-raised) because Alert Red reads only 3.65:1 on Dark Blue.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card outlines (not meaningful, so below 3:1 is fine). Dark: #293f64 — Dark Blue with 16% white, derived.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, radios and outline controls — meets 3:1 (3.7:1 on white, 3.3:1 on Light Neutral, 4.5:1 on Dark Blue, 3.45:1 on surface-raised dark).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Emphatic rules and table heads.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary CTA fill, checked controls, progress fills. Light: Sophos Blue + on-action White (8.6:1). Dark: Cyber Blue + on-action Dark Blue (11.7:1) — the guide's dark-ground CTA.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of action.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label colour on an action fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Cyber Green highlight fill (green CTA, highlight chips, accent strokes on dark). Always with on-accent Dark Blue text.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed fill of accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent (11.6:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline with 2px offset. Light: Violet (7.3:1 on white, 6.5:1 on Light Neutral). Dark: Cyber Blue (11.7:1 on Dark Blue).

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: Critical severity fill; on-status-critical text.

tokens.name: on-status-critical
tokens.usage: Text on status-critical (4.64:1).

tokens.name: status-high
tokens.usage: High severity fill; Dark Blue text.

tokens.name: status-medium
tokens.usage: Medium severity / warning fill; Dark Blue text.

tokens.name: status-low
tokens.usage: Low severity fill; Dark Blue text.

tokens.name: status-safe
tokens.usage: Safe / resolved fill; Dark Blue text.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Informational fill; Dark Blue text (5.8:1).

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text on every status fill except critical.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal backdrop — Dark Blue at 60%.
